sloka: हा महार्हः महाबाहो हा मम प्रिय पश्य माम् ।जनम् न पश्यसि इमम् त्वम् कस्मात् शोक अभिपीडितम् ॥४-२५-४१॥
transliteration: hā mahārhaḥ mahābāho hā mama priya paśya mām ।janam na paśyasi imam tvam kasmāt śoka abhipīḍitam ॥4-25-41॥

translations.english: 'O revered self even though you are bereft of life, your face looks cheerful. It carries the colour of the setting Sun, and looks the same when you were alive.
